[LCST.4.6.1] The type-headed call forms `Json(x)`, `Float(x)`, `Int(x)`, and the
unit-assertion call `<unit>(x)` are not admitted. Authors write `x::Json`,
`x::Float`, `x::Int`, `x::<unit>`. The compiler must reject the call forms with
`DS_VALIDATE_COERCION_FORM_REMOVED`, naming the `::` form as the replacement.
